description: An interactive field guide to the lunar landing attempts of 2019–2025: Beresheet's restart command, HAKUTO-R's altitude filter and five-kilometre fall, Luna-25's long burn, Peregrine's valve, SLIM's pinpoint landing and why it ended upside down, Odysseus and Athena tipping over, Blue Ghost's upright success and Resilience's late rangefinder, with a descent budget, a landing ellipse on a crater field, a tip-over envelope and a dated scorecard of every attempt.
og: Fourteen lunar landing missions flew between 2019 and 2025; five ended upright. Budget a descent, watch an altitude filter reject the truth, shrink a landing ellipse between craters and find the sideways speed that tips a lander, checked against NASA, JAXA, ISRO and mission reports.
brand: TOUCHDOWN — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
